scenes.heading: INT. BOARDING SCHOOL - DORM ROOM - NIGHT

lines.text: CAMERA PASSES DIGBY lying beneath a desk to FIND YOUNG NED, who
carefully pulls a PLAY-DOH BOY from a battered shoe box.
Bedtime at the Longborough School for Boys was
a time for dreams. Dreams filled with the
bliss that came from a happy childhood.
He steps aside TO REVEAL a creation on his dorm floor--
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
But on this night, one boy chose to dream with
his eyes wide open.
CAMERA PULLS BACK THROUGH the cardboard landscape. The streets
are filled with FROZEN PLAY-DOH PEOPLE, not yet alive.
11 weeks, 1 day, 7 hours and 41 minutes ago,
Young Ned was living that happy childhood...
Young Ned’s hand puts a PLAY-DOH BOY into FRAME next to A PLAY-
DOH WOMAN.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
...complete with a lovely home, caring mother
and boyhood sweetheart. A girl he called Chuck.
A PLAY-DOH GIRL is placed on the other side of the street from
the Play-Doh boy and woman.

scenes.heading: INT. BOARDING SCHOOL - DORM ROOM - NIGHT

lines.text: Young Ned puts the final touches on his Play-Doh city.
But when his mother died, twice, Young Ned
awoke to a new reality.
The Play-Doh boy and girl ANIMATE, coming to life with the power
of Young Ned’s imagination.
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 2.
CONTINUED:
Though he could reanimate the dead, he could
only animate the inanimate with his
imagination.
The Play-Doh boy and girl run toward each other, but before they
can touch, they FALL APART.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
On this lonely night, he tried to recreate his
past life, but he’d lost his ability to dream,
and found even his imagination failed him.

scenes.heading: INT. BOARDING SCHOOL - DORM ROOM - NIGHT

lines.text: A sad Young Ned watches his Play-Doh people CRUMBLE and BREAK,
hardened with age. Even Digby sighs for him.
As CAMERA PUSHES IN on Young Ned...
Still, he wore hope on his head.
CAMERA BOOMS DOWN to the RODAN-INSPIRED FEET he wears as shoes.
He stands and moves to the window, looking out into the night.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
And what Young Ned didn’t know was at that very
moment--
CAMERA PUSHES IN on the moon...
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
--the girl he called Chuck...
CAMERA PULLS BACK to find we are in--
...was wearing hope on hers.
YOUNG CHUCK stands on the balcony to her bedroom, wearing her
own GODZILLA SHOES, as she stares out into the night.
SPLIT SCREEN TO INCLUDE:
Young Ned looks out at the moon.
They were together, even if they were far apart.
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 3.
CONTINUED:
PUSH IN on Young Ned... And PULL OUT TO REVEAL he’s now--
GROWN-UP NED
Lying in bed. His eyes flutter OPEN.
Little did they know that when they would wake 19
years, 51 weeks, 2 days, 9 hours and 13 minutes
later...
NED’S POV: CHUCK in her bed, sleeping peacefully. We’re--
Ned watches Chuck with a smile.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
...they would again be together. Yet still,
so far apart.
Chuck’s eyes OPEN, almost sensing Ned’s gaze.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
For unfortunately, the Pie-Maker could never,
ever touch her.
You were watching me sleep.
Um, no. Sort of. But mainly I was just
waiting for you to wake up. And in the
process of waiting for you to wake up, I was,
yes, I was watching you sleep.
You do that a lot, don’t you?
It’s like watching you come back to life.
Again.
Smiles from both and they throw off the covers. Chuck joyfully
hops out of bed, only to CATCH her foot on the edge of the rug,
which sends her SAILING forward right onto--
Ned, still lying in bed, having broken her fall.
CLOSE ON Ned’s BARE hands wrapped around her BARE arms.
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 4.
CONTINUED:
He instantly DROPS HER. Knee-jerk reaction.
CLOSE ON their WIDE eyes, staring directly into each other’s.
Chuck BLINKS, clearly not dead (again).
You’re not--
She reaches out and touches his cheek...
How am I not--
He reaches out and caresses her arm...
Maybe it wears off. Maybe there’s an eclipse.
Maybe-- Wow. Your skin feels amazing.
Stop talking.
THEY KISS EACH OTHER. Beautiful. Passionate. The second kiss
they’ve both wanted so badly (without the anticipated results).
CHUCK (CONT’D)
We’re wearing too many clothes.
They come apart to breathe and Ned pulls off his shirt as Chuck
pulls off her nightgown (we only see her back, keeping things
PG). They EMBRACE the ultimate embrace.
CHUCK (CONT’D)
I’m still wearing too many clothes.
But you’re not wearing any--
She grins mischievously and reaches around her waist and--
LITERALLY PULLS HER SKIN UP AND AWAY TO REVEAL:
OLIVE underneath. She wears a come-hither smile...
NED (CONT’D)
Oh.
Much better.
She GRABS Ned and pulls him toward her. Before they kiss:
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 5.
CONTINUED: (2)
OLIVE (CONT’D)
Don’t tell Chuck.
Their lips connect and they kiss deeply. Ned is stunned when--
NED’S EYES OPEN (FOR REAL)
His POV: No Olive, just Chuck sleeping peacefully, as in the
dream. Her eyes OPEN and she smiles at Ned.
You were watching me sleep.
Um, yes, I was.
You do that a lot, don’t you?
Yes, I do.
The Pie-Maker wanted to tell Chuck that he liked
watching the moment she waked. That it was like
watching her come back to life. Again. So
instead he said nothing.
He quickly throws off the covers and heads to the--
So the Pie-Maker sought to use Emerson Cod as a
sounding board for that reality, which recently
included a moonlit kiss with one Olive Snook.
Ned places a dish of pie in front of EMERSON and sits across
from him. Emerson looks up from his tea.
I don’t need no damn pie.
It’s three-plum.
What I need is no plum. No plum, no pounds.
You love three-plum. And clearly you’re
hungry. That’s why you’re so cranky.
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 6.
CONTINUED:
Respect my discipline. Just ‘cause I love a
thing, don’t mean I can have a thing. Which
is a sentiment you might wanna investigate.
As CAMERA PUSHES IN on Ned...
The Pie-Maker had investigated this sentiment
and unfortunately for Emerson Cod, he now
needed to talk about it.
...he glances over at Olive and Chuck at the ice cream counter,
drying dishes together side by side.
I had a sexy dream about Olive last night.
Which I’m sure was influenced by a reality-
based kiss. By the road. You know.
There’s no way for this conversation to be
anything but awkward for me.
She was wearing a Chuck suit. In the dream.
Not by the road. What do you think that
means? Beyond the obvious.
I’m no dream-interpreter. Dream’s just your
brain processing random rigmarole it couldn’t
find a place for. Don’t mean nothing more than
you feel guilty ‘cause you kissed Olive when
you wanna be kissing a dead girl you can’t.
I said “beyond the obvious.” And Olive kissed
me. A friendly expression of innocent gratitude.
Was it a wet kiss or a dry kiss?
There was a little moisture. I guess.
She dropped a bomb in your subconscious with
her saliva. She knew what she was doing.
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 7.
CONTINUED: (2)
You make it sound so devious. And it’s not.
It meant nothing, which is why Chuck doesn’t
need to know.
Emerson Cod had a very particular view on
romantic relations and that view was this:
Some women love like gangsters. They ask you,
“Oh, baby, you bleeding? How’d that happen?”
as they hide a razor in their weave.
Olive isn’t a gangster. She’s my friend.
A friend who wants to tap that ass.
She does not want to tap that ass. This ass.
(then)
Does she?
Why you think she’s always rubbing up on you?
To be nice. In an employer-employee kind of
way where niceness occasionally includes
platonic rubbing.
Nothing platonic about it.
Ned’s eyes fall back on Olive. Emerson smiles.
EMERSON (CONT’D)
You’re coming undone, ain’t ya? Bomb she
dropped woke you up to the fact you might
wanna touch the one you can touch.
I don’t wanna touch Olive. Not in that way.
In fact, the Pie-Maker was coming undone. And
he thought he might want to touch Olive. In
that way. As he wrestled with the meaning of
Olive’s affections...
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 8.
CONTINUED: (3)
SWING OVER TO FIND Olive and Chuck at the ice cream counter,
drying off the dishes.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
...Olive wrestled with her own emotions about
the kiss. So she confessed:
It didn’t mean a thing, which is why I’m telling
you. Just a friendly expression of innocent
gratitude. A peck. It didn’t even last a
second. In fact... one-thousand-one. See. It
couldn’t have been half that.
Half?
Third. Maybe even a quarter. Very brief. He
didn’t mention it?
No. Should he have?
No.
As Chuck studies Olive...
Olive Snook was saddened her kiss wasn’t worth
a mention.
Ned deserves a friendly expression of innocent
gratitude. I’m sure he appreciated it. But I
don’t think I’d like it if you did it again.
I don’t think I’d like it, either. I mean, I
would... but not in this context.
That having been said, were his lips soft?
You don’t know?
We don’t touch. Directly. Prophylactically,
yes. But nothing more.
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 9.
CONTINUED: (4)
You don’t touch. You don’t. I’ve been
watching you. Not obsessively. Just paying
attention. You don’t touch.
Can’t.
That’s why you kiss with plastic food wrap. I
couldn’t get my head around it. Do you have
some kind of deadly food allergy... to Ned?
I’m going to say yes. I get hives, swelling,
eczema, blisters. Things to avoid.
And no salve will soothe it?
No.
That’s the most tragic thing I’ve ever heard.
Not including the big-ticket items like
genocide and famine. But tragic nonetheless.
Chuck can’t help but smile.
Oh, I don’t know... it’s really not so bad.
And it wasn’t. Yet. At that very moment, 14
miles due west as a crow flies, Harold Hundin
was experiencing something much more tragic...

scenes.heading: INT. PAPEN COUNTY KENNEL CLUB - HUNDIN’S OFFICE - DAY

lines.text: HAROLD HUNDIN looks up from his coffee and reacts to something
off-screen. His thermal cup slips from his hands.
...his murder.
The thermal cup TUMBLES TO THE FLOOR IN SLOW MOTION, then...
QUICK SHOTS, HITCHCOCK-STYLE (NOTE: THIS IS AN HOMAGE TO THE
MURDER IN “PSYCHO” AND AT NO TIME WILL WE SEE PENETRATION):
-- THE FLASH OF A BLADE. Actually, it’s the pointed handle of a
designer dog brush, but it’s nice and stabby nonetheless.
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 10.
CONTINUED:
-- HAROLD HUNDIN’S FACE GOES SLACK WITH STUNNED AWE. STTPPPFF.
We HEAR the dog brush handle plunge into his chest. STTPPFF-
STTPPFF. He’s stabbed again and again.
-- THE DOG BRUSH HANDLE. Bloody (stylized) and menacing.
-- CLOSE ON HAROLD HUNDIN. STTPPFF-STTPPFF-STTPPFF.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
The facts were these: Harold Hundin...
CAMERA PUSHES IN on Harold Hundin. FLASHING cameras, surrounded
by FOUR DOGS on pedestals sporting blue ribbons: A border
collie, Jack Russell terrier, poodle and Labrador retriever.
...a renowned dog breeder and president of the
Papen County Kennel Club, was 37 years, 11
weeks, 5 days, 1 hour and 2 minutes old...

scenes.heading: INT. PAPEN COUNTY KENNEL CLUB - HUNDIN’S OFFICE

lines.text: Harold falls in SLOW MOTION, stabbed and dying, silhouetted by
the window behind him, the dog brush still in his chest...
...when he was stabbed multiple times in his
office at the Papen County Kennel Club.
Harold tumbles to the floor across the kennel club emblem.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
The kennel club offered a reward for information
leading to the arrest of his killer.
CAMERA FOLLOWS Emerson, Chuck and Ned into the morgue, as the
CORONER looks on. Emerson slaps a wad of cash into his palm and
the coroner smiles big. Emerson shakes his head, annoyed.
And where there was a reward, there was
Emerson Cod.
Chuck and Emerson look on as Ned PULLS BACK the sheet from the
corpse of Harold Hundin -- we see several clean stab wounds all
over his chest. Ned STARTS HIS WATCH and TOUCHES Harold.
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 11.
CONTINUED:
Hello, Mr. Hundin. We’re gonna move through
things quickly and efficiently, so pay close
attention ‘cause this concerns you. You have one
minute to answer a brief series of questions.
Short, concise answers are best.
But feel free to elaborate when needed.
When does my minute start?
About 15 seconds ago.
Chuck coaxes Emerson to speak:
Any last wishes or would’a-should’a-could’a’s?
I wish I could’a said goodbye to Bubblegum.
I have stick gum.
I prefer mints myself.
Bubblegum’s my dog. If you people are angels,
I’d love it if you’d surround her with white
light and positive energy, or whatever it is
you do. She’s a sweet girl. Special needs.
White light. Check. Next question.
He coaxes Chuck to speak -- it’s her turn.
Who stabbed you, Mr. Hundin?
There was stabbing. But nobody stabbed me.

scenes.heading: INT. PAPEN COUNTY KENNEL CLUB - HUNDIN’S OFFICE - DAY

lines.text: Harold Hundin drops his thermal coffee cup, as before, and we
see what happened before we CUT AWAY last time.
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 12.
CONTINUED:
Harold Hundin detailed the strange series of
events that resulted in his stabbing.
QUICK SHOTS:
-- HAROLD HUNDIN TAKES A STEP... slips on the spilled coffee
from the thermal cup.
-- HAROLD STUMBLES BACK... spins to catch himself.
-- THE DESIGNER DOGGY BRUSH... sits in the basket of dog toys on
his desk, gleaming.
-- HAROLD FALLS ON THE END OF THE BRUSH... and is stabbed.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
A puddle of spilled coffee, an unfortunately-
positioned designer dog brush with an
unfortunately-sharp end and his own tenacity
expedited his death...
WIDE. Harold pushes himself up and falls again on the brush.
And again. He keeps doing it, his feet slipping on the floor.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
...but were not the primary cause.
CAMERA PUSHES IN on the thermal cup sitting in a pool of spilled
coffee.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
Before Harold Hundin could inadvertently and
repeatedly stab himself... he was poisoned.
As before. Ned, Chuck and Emerson look over the undead Harold.
I tasted almonds in my coffee. Real bitter.
Exceptionally bitter. With an intense,
charismatic flavor that could only be cyanide.
You could taste the cyanide?
A dog could taste it. And they only have one-
sixth the number of taste buds that I have.
Then, fool, why did you drink it?
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 13.
CONTINUED:
I was using an almond-flavored coffee cream
creamer in my coffee. I thought maybe it went
bad, but there were no curdles and... by the
time I figured I was poisoned, it was too late.
Who gave you the coffee?
My wife. Oh, honey. How could you?
Now that’s gangster love.
(to Harold)
Don’t you worry. “Oh, honey’s” gonna get
what’s coming to her.
Ned reaches out and TOUCHES Harold and he dies.
EMERSON (CONT’D)
Wasn’t that nice? You ask a question. You
get an answer. There’s no room for butt-
scuttle or misinterpretation. Thank you,
Lord, for little things like “My wife did it.”
OMIT
Ned and Chuck are sitting at the counter as Emerson arrives,
throwing a file in front of them.
Did you find Harold Hundin’s wife?
All four of ‘em. Sonofabitch was a damn
polygamist.
CLOSE ON - WEDDING ALBUM
The book flips open to a wedding picture.
Harold Hundin was indeed a damn polygamist
with multiple Mrs.’s of which there were four.
CAMERA PUSHES IN ON THE PICTURE OF Harold standing next to his
first bride, a beautiful woman named HILARY.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
Hilary was his first.
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 14.
CONTINUED:
NEXT PHOTO. Harold is now standing next to his second bride, a
beautiful woman named HEATHER. Hilary stands beside her in a
bridesmaid’s dress, holding a bouquet.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
Heather his second.
NEXT PHOTO. Harold is now standing next to his third bride, a
beautiful woman named SIMONE. Hilary and Heather stand beside
her in bridesmaids’ dresses, holding bouquets.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
Simone his third.
NEXT PHOTO. Harold is now standing next to his fourth and final
and youngest bride, HALLIE.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
And Hallie was his fourth and final wife.
CAMERA PULLS BACK TO REVEAL Hilary, Heather, Simone beside
Hallie in bridesmaids’ dresses, holding bouquets.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
But only one of the Hundin wives killed their
husband.
A FINAL FLASHBULB POP and we...
OMIT
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT TWO 15.

scenes.heading: INT. PIE HOLE - DINING AREA - DAY

lines.text: Wondering why her kiss with the Pie-Maker went
unmentioned, Olive Snook attempted to mention
the unmentionable.
Ned is ENTERING from the kitchen, approaching Chuck and Emerson
sitting in a booth. But before he can get close, Olive catches
up with him and grabs his sleeve for a quick aside:
Pss-pss-pss. We should clear the air.
Does our air need clearing?
Our relations. By the road.
Oh. That. I haven’t thought another...
thought about that.
Ned moves away as quickly as he can and joins Emerson and Chuck
mid-conversation. Olive is close on Ned’s heels.
Four wives. That’s greedy.
And intriguing.
Olive sets the tray down and joins them. Ned squirms, a little
uncomfortable by her presence.
Some folks prefer vanilla. Some folks prefer
chocolate. Other folks like their Neapolitan.
I like Neapolitan.
Then you’d do well as a polygamist. One woman
to have, one woman to hold.
Chuck and Olive look at one another. Ned looks at Emerson.
Why. Why would you do that?
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT TWO 16.
CONTINUED:
I apologize. Mouth got a little ahead of me.
Chuck began to wonder if the Pie-Maker would
indeed do well as a polygamist.
For the record, I would be a horrible
polygamist. I’m easily distracted. I
wouldn’t know where to focus.
Harold Hundin knew where to focus. Found
himself the perfect wife, except she had four
heads. And they’re all breeders, too.
They make children for their polygamy cult?
Dog breeders.
Digby’s ears PERK to the mention of that.
They make dogs for their polygamy cult?
Nobody’s making nothing for no polygamy cult.
So which wife wanted to kill him most?
How do you know a wife did it?
A furtive exchange of glances between Chuck, Ned and Emerson.
He left a note.
A note? How mysterious. Can I play?
No. Sorry. Emerson doesn’t like--
A disappointed Olive starts to leave.
Although...
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT TWO 17.
CONTINUED: (2)
I love a good “although.”
Olive plops herself back down.
Me, too.
...the same faces show up four different
places asking suspicious questions, they’ll be
onto us faster than you can say “monogamy.”
We got four suspects, four partners in
business... and four faces.
Ned stares at Emerson, who smiles back. Gotcha, sucka’.
Does that mean I get to play?
If you’re playing, you’re not getting paid.
And the suspects were these:
CLOSE ON Hilary Hundin. CAMERA PULLS BACK TO REVEAL her
standing in her boutique store filled with designer doggy items.
Hilary Hundin, owner and chief executive
officer of Prêt-à-Poochie Designer Dogwear and
Accessories. She was the first to join Harold
in matrimony.
CAMERA CONTINUES PULLING BACK TO REVEAL Hilary’s prized POODLE
at her side, adorned in an abundance of bling.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
Like the poodles she bred, Hilary Hundin was
generally pleasant, happy and perky, but might
snap if teased or surprised.

scenes.heading: INT. HEATHER HUNDIN’S PET PSYCHOLOGY OFFICE - DAY

lines.text: CLOSE ON Heather Hundin. CAMERA PULLS BACK TO REVEAL she is
seated in her therapist’s chair with pad and pencil.
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT TWO 18.
CONTINUED:
Pluralizing the marriage was Heather Hundin, a
renowned pet psychologist and host of the
weekly radio show: “Doggonit.”
CAMERA CONTINUES PULLING BACK TO REVEAL Heather’s prized BORDER
COLLIE reclining on the proverbial psychiatric couch.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
Like her prize-winning border collies, Heather
was friendly and energetic, but could turn
destructive and neurotic if bored or ignored.

scenes.heading: INT. SIMONE HUNDIN’S K-18 OBEDIENCE DOG TRAINING STUDIO - DAY

lines.text: CLOSE ON Simone Hundin. CAMERA PULLS BACK TO REVEAL Simone
standing in her studio among a variety of training equipment. A
colorful KAPRALIK of the four Hundin purebreds hangs on the wall.
Simone Hundin was Harold’s third wife. She
pioneered K-18 Obedience, where demanding dog
owners got double from their K-9s.
CAMERA CONTINUES PULLING BACK TO REVEAL Simone has assembled a
line of THREE JACK RUSSELL TERRIERS.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
Like the Jack Russell terriers she trained and bred,
Simone possessed strong hunting instincts that, if
left unchecked, could result in deadly aggression.
Simone points her finger at the row of dogs like a gun.
Bang-bang.
The Jack Russells fall over simultaneously, playing dead.
Simone blows the imaginary smoke off her fingertip.
CLOSE ON Hallie Hundin and her CHOCOLATE LABRADOR. She slaps a
leash into SOMEONE’S O.C. HAND and CAMERA BEGINS TO PULL BACK...
Harold Hundin’s fourth and final wife was young
Hallie, who bred Labradors and donated them as
Seeing Eye dogs to the blind.
CAMERA PULLS BACK TO REVEAL Hallie is standing in front of a row
of THREE BLIND PEOPLE. They’re all holding leashes attached to
beautiful LABRADOR DOGS standing obediently at attention.
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT TWO 19.
CONTINUED:
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
Like her Labs, Hallie was loyal, friendly and
competitively obedient. She craved human
attention, but if denied, her competitive
obedience could go horribly awry.
Hallie smiles at the blind people, who don’t return her smile
because they can’t see it. Her smile fades only a little.
EMERSON’S CONVERTIBLE pulls up in front of the boutique store.
Ned is in the driver’s seat beside Emerson, with Olive, Chuck
and Digby in the back. Three of them open their doors.
Wait.
Three doors slam shut.
EMERSON (CONT’D)
We’re going in undercover. And by undercover
I mean under no circumstances are you to give
out any factual information about your person.
You want us to lie?
I want you to lie consistently. And we all
gotta take turns with the dog.
He has a name, you know.
And you better lie about that, too.
(to Olive)
You’re up first. We’ll wait here.
The DOORBELL CHIMES as Olive and Digby ENTER.
You have a gorgeous selection of couture.
Pickle loves him some D&G.
Digby, aka Pickle, BARKS and smiles. Hilary opens her mouth to
speak, but before she can, Digby BARKS again and again.
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT TWO 20.
CONTINUED:
OLIVE (CONT’D)
(re: the D&G doggy garment)
Pickle wants to know if this comes in green.
I’m just kidding. He didn’t really say that.
(extends her hand)
Hello. I’m Pimento. And you are?

scenes.heading: INT. HEATHER HUNDIN’S PET PSYCHOLOGY OFFICE - DAY

lines.text: Ned and Digby sit on the psychoanalyst’s couch -- opposite ends.
Ned.
Have you had Ned since he was a puppy?
CAMERA PULLS BACK TO REVEAL Heather sitting in her therapist’s
chair with pencil and pad on her lap.
Ned and I have been together a very long time.
We’re intimate. But it’s the appropriate
human-canine sort of intimacy.
Clearly it’s not an affectionate relationship.
It’s very affectionate. It’s just... Ned’s
been having strange dreams lately. His paws
twitch and he whimpers. It’d be cute if it
weren’t so sad. He may be experiencing stress-
related anxiety due to, um... mating issues.
You wanna know what I think?
Uh...

scenes.heading: INT. SIMONE HUNDIN’S K-18 OBEDIENCE DOG TRAINING STUDIO - DAY

lines.text: Emerson drags Digby into the studio. He pulls at his leash and
is generally disrespecting Emerson.
SIMONE (O.S.)
He doesn’t respect you.
CAMERA PULLS BACK TO REVEAL Simone standing next to him.
He respects me.
PUSHING DAISIES #105 "Bitches" 10/31/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT TWO 21.
CONTINUED:
[Note: in the foreground is a pedestal with a porcelain dog
statue wearing a collar that says “B.G.” for “Bubblegum.”]
